source_alignment.note: This file closes the four-part app-agent bank with short-session context, follow-up routing, aliases, and optional contextual suggestions. No app code is modified here.

purpose: Conversation context, follow-up routing, entity aliases, contextual suggestions, and short-session memory for the free-text EyeMakkah consumer assistant.

truthfulness: Do not claim live LLM/API connectivity.
Do not invent unresolved objects, offers, prices, availability, crowding, bookings, or operational status.
Do not expose personal data, exact user locations, attendee identities, or nearby-user lists.
Do not convert community contributions into official facts.
Do not collapse Save, Add to Plan, Join, Booking handoff, Confirmed, Attended, or Completed into one state.
Do not recommend expired offers/events or paused/dormant groups as active.

resolution_order: normalize language and text using Part 01 guidance
resolve explicit named objects and entities using aliases plus normalized current inventory titles
detect explicit action verbs and action targets
detect explicit context changes such as neighborhood, party, time, mode, category, or offer requirement
match high-confidence standalone intents from Parts 01–03
for short/referential text, match Part 04 follow-up intents
reuse prior intent only when the follow-up clearly depends on it
apply explicit new entities/context over old conversational entities
ask one concise clarification if multiple referents remain plausible
never invent a missing object, offer, state, source, price, ranking, or value
guardrails: Do not resolve 'هذا/ذاك/هو/it/that/this' when multiple plausible objects remain.
An explicit new object, area, time, party, category, or offer requirement overrides an older one.
A short follow-up may reuse the previous intent only when its meaning depends on the previous turn.
Do not use precise location unless the user has actually shared/granted it; selected neighborhood is sufficient for many proximity answers.
Never infer a sensitive trait from behavior or community membership.
If an offer filter removes all results, say no matching active offer is represented rather than inventing one.
If the user says 'احجزه', booking handoff semantics from Part 03 apply; never jump directly to Confirmed.
If the user says 'ضفه لخطتي', preserve Save/Join/Booking states unless separately requested.
If an item is expired, ended, paused, or dormant, it must not be surfaced as an active recommendation.
Contextual suggestions are optional UI aids and are never treated as user intent until selected.

intents.purpose: Explain why the previous recommendation/result was selected, using only the ranking/context signals available for that result.
